Du willst nach dem Studium nicht Folien bauen, sondern Verantwortung übernehmen? Bei Justhome begleitest du Menschen bei der größten finanziellen Entscheidung ihres Lebens – dem Immobilienkauf. Du arbeitest mit KI-Tools, die dir 70 % der Administration abnehmen, bekommst exklusive, kaufbereite Anfragen statt Kaltakquise und verdienst ab Tag 1 mit an deinem Erfolg.
Wir sind ein kapitalgestütztes Wachstumsunternehmen im Herzen Berlins und digitalisieren die Baufinanzierung – einen Markt, der technologisch Jahre hinterherhinkt. Genau deshalb suchen wir keine klassischen Banker, sondern analytisch starke Absolvent:innen, die schnell lernen und gern verkaufen.
Aufgaben
Beraten & Abschließen: Du verwandelst qualifizierte Kundenanfragen in passgenaue Finanzierungslösungen – im Gespräch per Video und Telefon, ohne Kaltakquise.
Tech statt Tippen: Unsere KI-gestützten Tools strukturieren Daten, formulieren E-Mails vor und bereiten die Einreichung bei über 700 Bankpartnern vor. Du konzentrierst dich auf den Kunden.
Netzwerk nutzen: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren 170+ Partner-Maklerunternehmen zusammen – die technische Integration liefert dir Objektunterlagen oft, bevor du das erste Telefonat führst.
Produkt mitgestalten: Du gibst direktes Feedback an unser Tech-Team und prägst so mit, wie unsere Tools von morgen aussehen.
Qualifikation
Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (z.B. BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften – auch dual) oder eine Bankausbildung
Analytische Stärke, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Empathie, Menschen bei ihrer wichtigsten finanziellen Entscheidung sicher zu begleiten
Hunger, in Rekordzeit zum Finanzierungsexperten aufzusteigen – Vorkenntnisse in Baufinanzierung brauchst du nicht
Wichtig zu wissen: Für den Start brauchst du die Sachkundeprüfung nach §34i GewO – nicht aber für deine Bewerbung. Wir geben dir eine Zusage vorab. Wenn du bei uns einsteigst, erstatten wir dir die Prüfungs- und Vorbereitungskosten im Umfang von bis zu 1.000 €.

Attraktives Gehaltspaket: €60.000 Zielgehalt im ersten Jahr (Fixum + ungedeckelte Provision). Bei sehr guter Leistung sind im zweiten Jahr €70.000–90.000 realistisch - und auch das ist nicht die Obergrenze.
Echte Aufstiegsperspektive: Führungsverantwortung als Teamleiter:in in zwei Jahren ist bei uns ein realer Karrierepfad, weil wir kontinuierlich wachsen.
Hybrid arbeiten: Nach der Probezeit 3 Tage im Loft-Büro am Rosenthaler Platz, 2 Tage Home Office.
Beste Ausstattung: Dein Mitarbeiter-Laptop und unsere starke CRM-Technologie unterstützen dich im Arbeitsalltag
Team, das zusammenhält: Wir feiern Erfolge gemeinsam – zuletzt mit dem ganzen Team beim Bootfahren und Grillen auf der Havel.
So einfach bewirbst du dich
Kein Anschreiben nötig. Schick uns deinen CV oder einfach dein LinkedIn-/Xing-Profil – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden zurück.

Für unseren Kunden Elephant , ein schnell wachsendes AI-SaaS-Unternehmen, suchen wir einen erfahrenen (Senior) Full Cycle Account Executive (m/w/d) .
Mit Elephants SaaS Lösung haben Frontline Teams jederzeit Zugriff auf Wissen, Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen und KI-gestützte Unterstützung – direkt im Arbeitsalltag. Das spart Zeit, steigert Produktivität und sorgt dafür, dass Menschen ihre Arbeit einfacher und sicherer erledigen können.
Mehr als 90 Unternehmen vertrauen bereits auf Elephant – darunter Enpal, 1KOMMA5°, Hörmann, TÜV Süd, DEKRA, Daimler Trucks und GEA.
Jetzt suchen wir erfahrene Full Cycle Account Executives , die komplexe B2B-SaaS-Deals eigenständig gewinnen und die Go-to-Market-Strategie aktiv mitgestalten möchten.
Deine Mission
Du verantwortest den kompletten Sales Cycle – von der ersten Outbound-Nachricht bis zur Vertragsunterschrift.
Bei uns bekommst du keine vorqualifizierten Opportunities übergeben. Du baust deine Pipeline selbst auf (ca. 70 % Outbound, 30 % Inbound), entwickelst Beziehungen zu Entscheidern und führst komplexe Buying Center sicher bis zum Closing.
Wichtig: Wir verkaufen ein innovatives AI-Produkt an mittelständische und große Unternehmen. Unsere Deals dauern häufig mehrere Monate und beinhalten Geschäftsführung, Fachbereiche, IT, Datenschutz und teilweise Betriebsräte.
Wenn dich komplexe Enterprise-nahe Sales-Prozesse reizen, wirst du hier viel bewegen können.
Aufgaben
Du identifizierst neue Zielkunden und baust deine eigene Pipeline durch strukturiertes Outbound auf.
Du führst Discovery Calls und Produktdemos eigenständig durch.
Du steuerst komplexe Buying Center und entwickelst Champions innerhalb der Kundenorganisation.
Du begleitest Verhandlungen bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.
Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Foundern zusammen und bringst deine Learnings direkt in Produkt, Positionierung und GTM-Prozesse ein.
Du entwickelst neue ICPs, Outbound-Sequenzen und Sales-Prozesse mit und testest kontinuierlich neue Ansätze.
Du repräsentierst Elephant auf Messen, Events und bei Kundenterminen.
Qualifikation
Erfahrung im B2B SaaS Sales als Full Cycle Account Executive.
Du hast Deals selbst gesourct und erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
Erfahrung mit komplexen Sales Cycles über mehrere Monate und unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Nachweisbare Vertriebserfolge (z. B. Quota Attainment, Deal-Größen oder gewonnene Kunden).
Outbound gehört für dich selbstverständlich zum Alltag – Telefon, LinkedIn oder E-Mail.
Du kannst technische Produkte verständlich erklären und bewegst dich sicher im Austausch mit IT-Entscheidern.
AI-Tools gehören für dich selbstverständlich zu deinem Arbeitsalltag.
Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, triffst Entscheidungen und fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld wohl.
Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Job Overview This role is pivotal in nurturing and supporting customer relationships that promote satisfaction, performance improvement, growth, and retention across a portfolio of strategic accounts. Scope includes all Marchex solutions, including call intelligence and conversational analytics.

The Senior Account Manager acts as a partner and advocate to ensure each dealer fully utilizes Marchex products to meet and exceed their business objectives.

This includes translating data into actionable insights, demonstrating measurable ROI, and serving as the customer’s internal voice within Marchex by communicating needs and priorities to Sales Engineering, Product, Analytics, and Customer Support teams.

Job Impact The Senior Account Manager owns and manages a portfolio of accounts and is responsible for building strong relationships with key decision makers, including C-Suite leaders, General Managers, Marketing Directors, and technical leaders.

Responsibilities include maintaining deep knowledge of Marchex offerings to provide technical support and guidance, analyzing performance data and sentiment trends, identifying missed opportunities, and driving adoption of key features.

The role requires developing and implementing strategic account plans, delivering Strategic Business Reviews, identifying renewal risks early, and partnering with Sales to support retention and expansion opportunities. Team The Marchex Customer Success Team is dedicated to helping customers achieve their goals.

As part of the team, you are responsible for optimizing Marchex ’s value in the eyes of the clients by providing them with useful resources, reliable support and proof of value. As a team we are focused on fostering and developing a mutually beneficial relationship between Marchex and the customers we partner with.

Key Responsibilities Customer Relationship Management = 50% Manage and develop strong relationships with senior and working team client stakeholders. Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts and own the full lifecycle including onboarding, optimization, and renewal stages.

Lead and facilitate two-way communication between Marchex and customers, including organizing meeting agendas, presenting insights, and demonstrating features and benefits of the Marchex product suite. Conduct Strategic Business Reviews focused on performance metrics, ROI, improvement recommendations, and strategic planning.

Maintain accurate account data, lifecycle stages, and forecasting within CRM platforms. Identify renewal risks early using health scores, engagement indicators, and product usage trends and partner with leadership to mitigate risk accordingly.

Strategic Growth & Analytics = 40% Analyze call data, sentiment trends, and missed opportunities to produce actionable insights that drive performance improvement. Build strategic account plans including forecasting, utilization tracking, call and conversation data insights, and revenue progression.

Drive platform adoption across assigned accounts, ensuring customers maximize the value of the full Marchex solution. Work with Sales team to identify new revenue opportunities, up-sell and cross-sell pathways, and support contract renewals and expansions.

Seek innovative, datadriven solutions to problems and processes to ensure customer success and sustained business impact. Collaborate crossfunctionally with Product, Analytics, Engineering, and Support teams to address customer feedback and resolve technical or performance gaps.

Technical Support & Training = 10% Provide hands-on technical support to customers, ensuring quick resolution of platform questions, performance issues, or configuration challenges. Deliver ongoing product training for client stakeholders to ensure adoption and proficiency.

Assist new customers through onboarding, setup, and early-stage education to establish strong initial engagement. Collaborate with Support and Product teams to escalate and resolve complex technical inquiries. Maintain deep product knowledge to effectively guide users and ensure they are equipped to leverage the platform’s full capabilities.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications BA or BS preferred, or equivalent experience required. 5+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or consultative sales, ideally within automotive, SaaS, Martech, or digital media/marketing. Prior job experience in digital media/marketing or in related fields.

Good understanding of paid search optimization and reporting platforms i.e. Google Analytics, Ads and Microsoft Bing as well as CRM platforms considered an asset. Strong analytical skills and experience presenting datadriven insights, performance dashboards, or ROI analyses.

Experience managing large datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations. Demonstrated ability to independently manage a customer portfolio, including renewals and expansion opportunities. Highly motivated self-starter with demonstrated initiative and the ability to make decisions independently with limited supervision.

Must have superior in-person and virtual presentation and meeting management skills. Excellent and proven verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Comfortable navigating CRM systems, analytics dashboards, and reporting tools including Salesforce, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Wir sind Elephant und bauen die AI Trainings- & Wissensplattform für die Menschen, die reparieren, was kaputt ist, unsere Städte am Laufen halten und das Rückgrat unserer Zukunft bilden: Frontline Worker, also Techniker:innen, Monteur:innen und Werker:innen in der Produktion.
Unsere Mission: diesen Frontline Teams Superkräfte verleihen. Mit KI in der Hosentasche sind Trainings, Wissen, Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen und Echtzeit-Support sofort verfügbar. Aufgaben werden schneller fertig, die Produktivität steigt und Frontline Teams kommen früher nach Hause.
90+ Kunden vertrauen uns bereits. Von Climate-Tech-Scale-ups, wie Enpal oder 1Komma5, über den industriellen Mittelstand (Hörmann, Wanzl, Schmidbauer), bis hin zu großen Corporates (Dekra, TÜV Süd, Daimler Trucks, GEA).
Schnell wachsendes SaaS-Start-up, ~30 Leute, Offices in Berlin und Hamburg, hybrid. Wir legen Wert auf Feature Velocity, klare Kommunikation und keine Bürokratie. Unser Sales-Team ist klein, hungrig und arbeitet mit einem modernen AI-Stack (HubSpot, Apollo, Nooks, Lemlist, eigenes Enrichment und ja, wir nutzen Claude täglich – Ehrensache). Du arbeitest zusammen mit einem großartigen Team aus SDRs und AEs.
Aufgaben
Du verantwortest den kompletten Sales Cycle: eigenes Prospecting, Discovery, Demo, Multi-Stakeholder-Management, Verhandlung, Closing. Du baust eigenständig deine eigene Pipeline auf (ca. 70 % Outbound, 30 % Inbound) und führst sie sicher bis zur Unterschrift.
Das ist deine Challenge: Wir verkaufen ein innovatives KI-Produkt an den Deutschen Mittelstand - das ist kein Quick-Win-Business. Sales Cycle gehen über mehrere Monate, viele Stakeholder (Geschäftsführung, Fachbereich, IT, Datenschutz, manchmal Betriebsrat), und Organisationen, die ihre KI-Strategie gerade erst entwickeln. Du überzeugst nicht mit einem einzigen Pitch, sondern mit Ausdauer, strategischem Denken und echtem Stakeholder-Management.
Genau das macht die Rolle spannend: Du verhandelst mit verschiedenen Personas und gestaltest mit, wie KI traditionelle Unternehmen verändert. Wenn du auf knackige Sales Cycle und High Velocity-Sales stehst, wird dich das frustrieren. Wenn dich komplexe Deals mit echtem Impact reizen, bist du bei uns genau richtig.
🔎 Du identifizierst und qualifizierst Zielkunden, baust eigene Lead-Listen und Outbound-Kampagnen.
🧭 Du führst Discovery Calls und Demos selbst – vom Erstkontakt bis zum Entscheidergremium.
🧩 Du orchestrierst komplexe Buying Center: Champion aufbauen, IT und Datenschutz früh abholen, Momentum über Monate halten.
📄 Du führst Verhandlungen, erstellst Angebote und schließt deine Deals selbst.
⚙️ Du entwickelst unsere GTM Motion aktiv mit: Sequenzen, ICPs, neue Segmente, Prozesse — testen, lernen, skalieren.
🎤 Du vertrittst uns auf Messen und Events.
🤝 Du arbeitest direkt mit den Foundern, d. h. deine Learnings fließen unmittelbar in Produkt und Strategie.
Qualifikation
Du kennst beide Enden des Sales Cycles aus erster Hand: eigenes Sourcing und eigenes Closing. Ob du das als Full-Cycle AE gemacht hast oder dir das Fundament über SDR- und AE-Jahre erarbeitet hast, ist für uns zweitrangig.
Erfahrung mit komplexen Sales-Prozessen: Deals über 3+ Monate, mehrere Stakeholder, Procurement-, IT- und Datenschutzprozesse schrecken dich nicht ab – du kennst sie und weißt, wie man sie steuert.
Track Record, den du zeigen kannst: Quota-Attainment, Deal-Größen, gewonnene Logos. Wir werden konkret danach fragen.
Echte Outbound-DNA: Du greifst selbst zum Hörer, jede Woche, ohne dass es jemand anordnet.
Tech- & AI-Affinität: Du verstehst unser Produkt technisch, kannst mit IT-Leitern auf Augenhöhe sprechen und nutzt AI-Tools selbstverständlich im eigenen Workflow.
Ownership & Early-Stage-Mentalität: Kein fertiges Playbook, keine festen Strukturen. Du triffst Entscheidungen, machst Fehler, lernst schnell und brauchst niemanden, der dir sagt, was zu tun ist.
Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch.

Einzigartiges Produkt, das echte Probleme echter Menschen löst und Kunden begeistert.
Gestalten statt abarbeiten: Du prägst, wie Elephant verkauft. Deine Sequenzen, deine Prozesse, deine Handschrift.
High Impact: Direkter Draht zu den Foundern, kein Layer dazwischen, keine Bürokratie.
Riesiger Markt: 80 % der Weltbevölkerung arbeitet in Frontline Jobs. Der Markt ist weitgehend unerschlossen.
Bester Stack: Neueste Tools und volle Freiheit, Neues zu testen.
Der richtige Zeitpunkt: 90+ Kunden, wachsende Pipeline, Übergang von Founder-Led Sales zum skalierenden GTM-Team. Genau die Phase, in der ein AE den größten Unterschied macht.

🪐 Discover our galaxy
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here!
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.
The Mission 🪐
The Situation: Malt is cementing its position as the undeniable leader in the European freelance economy. While our tech-powered platform connects over 1,000,000 top-tier freelancers with 100,000+ companies, the Dutch Enterprise sector presents a massive, untapped frontier. This market is dominated by complex, multinational corporate structures with deeply entrenched procurement protocols that are ripe for disruption.
The Task: We are not hiring you to manage an existing portfolio or farm warm leads. You are being brought in to architect and own the zero-to-one enterprise acquisition strategy for the DACH region.

Operating as the "founder" of your territory, your mandate is to systematically penetrate massive global accounts, navigate labyrinthine procurement structures, and secure highly scalable, multi-country Master Service Agreements (MSAs) that will cement Malt's dominance in the German-speaking market and beyond.

Pillar 1: Strategic Territory Architecture & Hunting
Action: Map out complex, global enterprise accounts within the DACH region, aggressively designing and executing surgical prospecting strategies to breach heavily fortified multi-stakeholder environments (Procurement, HR, and independent Business Units).
Output: A localized, highly qualified pipeline of net-new DACH Enterprise logos and concrete, multi-threaded stakeholder maps.
Metrics of Performance: Enterprise GSV Pipeline Generated and CRM forecast integrity.
Pillar 2: Deal Orchestration & RFP Command
Action: Run rigorous, in-depth discovery utilizing the full MEDDIC framework to validate severe business pain, identify the true Economic Buyer, and aggressively lead end-to-end RFI/RFP processes alongside our Bid Management and technical teams.
Output: Compelling, ROI-driven business proposals and precisely engineered enterprise pilot programs designed to prove undeniable platform value.
Metrics of Performance: RFI/RFP Win Rate and Pilot-to-MSA Conversion Rate.
Pillar 3: Heavy-Weight Negotiation & Scalable Revenue Activation
Action: Command ruthless, complex negotiations for global Master Service Agreements involving tight friction with Legal, Finance, and Procurement across multiple countries. Upon signature, engineer the scalable handover strategy to the local Account Management teams.
Output: Executed, multi-country MSAs and comprehensive post-signature deployment kickoff plans.
Metrics of Performance: Total Contract Value (TCV) Signed and Deal Velocity (managing complex cycles efficiently without losing momentum).

s.h: Proven Mastery (What you have already built)
s.t:
A minimum of 8 years of quantifiable, proven track record hunting and closing complex, 7-figure B2B sales cycles within a SaaS/Tech environment.
Deep familiarity with the staffing, "future of work" industry, MSPs, or Tier 1 recruitment groups.
Demonstrated success navigating extremely long sales cycles and managing strategic concessions to close highly scalable deals.
Native-level fluency in German and full professional fluency in English.

Advanced MEDDIC Mastery: You will deploy this framework with such rigor that you act as the internal benchmark and can actively coach others on its nuances.
C-Suite ROI Narrative Construction: Mastering the art of delivering disruptive narratives that challenge legacy customer assumptions and shift C-level perspectives on the "Future of Work."
Cross-Border Deal Structuring: Developing top-tier acumen in multi-country legal, financial, and compliance orchestration.
The Self-Selection Filter ❓

s.h: This role is perfect for you if
s.t:
You are an elite hunter who actively enjoys the strategic friction of a complex enterprise sales cycle and navigating massive corporate red tape.
You operate with extreme ownership—you treat your pipeline like your own startup's P&L and do not wait for permission or inbound leads to execute.
You naturally think in terms of "Economic Buyers," "Decision Criteria," and "Validation Events" rather than just "having good meetings."

s.h: This role is NOT for you if
s.t:
You rely heavily on inbound marketing or a pre-packaged SDR playbook to hit your pipeline numbers.
You get easily intimidated by heavy-weight legal negotiations, aggressive procurement teams, or highly structured RFP processes.
You prefer predictable, transactional account maintenance over the high-stakes thrill of net-new, multi-country enterprise acquisition.
30-60-90 Day Impact Plan 🏁

Our Background
Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people.

Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems.

We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.
Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.
But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.
Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

About Zelara
Most CRM marketing still blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders experienced this firsthand in senior roles at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to build a better way.
Zelara is an agentic lifecycle marketing platform that improves with every interaction. It works with the CRM infrastructure our customers already use, replacing static journeys and manual segmentation with a system that creates content, makes individual-level decisions, and learns from every outcome.
With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift , measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers. Our founders still run the commercial side themselves. We are hiring the person who takes that over and turns it into a motion that does not depend on them.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature sales organisation and work a territory. Leads do not arrive from marketing, opportunities do not arrive from SDRs, and there is no playbook written by someone else for you to run.
This is a hands-on senior AE role: you carry a number and close your own deals. You own the commercial motion end-to-end at the moment it stops being founder-led: the pitch lands, the workshops work, paying customers are signing, and none of it is yet a system that someone other than a founder can repeat.
You own the full funnel, from identifying who is worth talking to through discovery, workshop, offer, negotiation, and signature, and on into the annual contract, expansion, and renewal. Annual contracts run €75–250k . Cycles run two to four months. Buying committees are a CRM champion, a technical stakeholder, and an economic buyer, and you need to know why each of them says no.
You and the Solutions Architect run each account as a pair, in a weekly rhythm and in the room together for the conversations that decide something. You are the account owner: pricing, proposals, contracts, conversion to an annual contract, expansion, renewal. They own the technical plan and the evidence behind those decisions.

Before signature they lead technical discovery alongside you; after signature they become the customer's named technical lead. You close; they make the value real and defensible.
You will sell to CRM, lifecycle, and marketing leaders at mid-market and enterprise B2C companies across Europe: fintech, e-commerce, travel, and employee benefits.

Own the full funnel from ICP identification to signed contract: source, qualify, run discovery, facilitate workshops, write offers, negotiate, and close
Close the next wave of customers alongside a founder, then without one, and turn closing from a personal skill into a system someone else can run
Win the build-versus-buy conversation: prepare it with the Solutions Architect, bring the evidence, and make the case to an engineering lead who would rather build it
Turn a working pitch into a documented playbook: write down what wins, retire what does not, and make the next hire productive from it
Run outbound as an experiment rather than a spray: test channels, messaging, and segments with a stated hypothesis and a result you are willing to act on
Shape ICP and positioning with real market signal, and feed what you hear in deals back to Product and Science rather than storing it in your head
Build the commercial foundation: pricing logic, contract mechanics, pipeline hygiene, and a forecast that holds up
Own the commercial side of expansion and renewal with the Solutions Architect: identify the opportunity, quantify the value, and de-risk the plan
Lead sales as the team grows: once the motion is repeatable, hire and coach the next account executives
You will not only work a pipeline. You will reason about every deal in terms of what it teaches us about the market, the product, and the motion, as part of a small, senior team, with real deals as your starting point.

30 Days (Immersion): Learn the ICP, the pipeline, the case study, and our AI-assisted sales tooling in your first two weeks. From week three, run discovery calls yourself, with a founder as backup, and take over your first live deals.
